title: The arrow keys steer the snake
description: The snake already moves on its own; pressing the Up arrow key turns it upward and pressing Left turns it leftward, with the keyboard alone enough to play.

steps.goal: On the Snake game, start a run if one is not already running. First watch without touching anything: the snake should already be moving. Then press the Up arrow key once and watch where the snake goes; next press the Left arrow key once and watch again.
success: The snake was already moving on its own before any key was pressed
After pressing Up the snake turned and moved upward
After pressing Left the snake turned and moved leftward
